stories.title: Jabs all up to date?
stories.body: See vaccination, farrier, dentist and physio dates, and what's due next, in one place.

stories.question: Has this ever happened to you?

stories.label: Kennel tip
stories.title: Check before you book
stories.body: Kennels usually ask for up-to-date jabs. Check his record before you book.

stories.question: How on top of due dates are you?

stories.label: From today's post
stories.title: Book the next farrier
stories.body: Six weeks slips to nine fast. Book the next visit before they leave. Swipe today's post for all six.

stories.question: How do you remember all the due dates?

stories.title: When was he last weighed?
stories.body: Log weigh-ins and body condition scores, and see the history at a glance.
